# EXCLUDED DELIBERATELY:
#   @@version, serverproperty('ProductVersion'/'ProductLevel')  - differ after any rebuild
#   getdate(), sysdatetime(), newid(), rand(), crypt_gen_random
#   db_name(), user_name(), suser_sname(), original_login(), @@spid
#   any error whose text embeds the database name, such as the 2019+ string-truncation message
#   auto-generated constraint names (PK__t__<hash>) - every constraint below is named

# --- integers and alignment (NumericTypes -> right-aligned separator row) ---
["select 1"]
["select 1 as i"]
["select cast(1 as bigint) as b, cast(2 as smallint) as s, cast(3 as tinyint) as t"]
["select cast(1 as bit) as b1, cast(0 as bit) as b0"]
["select -2147483648 as lo, 2147483647 as hi"]
["select cast(9223372036854775807 as bigint) as big"]
["select 1 as a, null as b, 'x' as c"]
["select 1 where 1 = 0"]

# --- floating point: fiddle.cs pins float to G15 and real to G7 ---
["select cast(1.5 as float) as f, cast(1.5 as real) as r"]
["select cast(1.0 / 3 as float) as f"]
["select cast(1.0 / 3 as real) as r"]
["select cast(0.1 as float) + cast(0.2 as float) as f"]
["select cast(1e-8 as float) as f, cast(1e20 as float) as g"]
["select sqrt(cast(2 as float)) as f"]

# --- decimal / numeric / money: decimal goes through GetSqlDecimal ---
["select cast(123.456 as decimal(10,3)) as d, cast(123.456 as numeric(10,3)) as n"]
["select cast(1 as decimal(38,0)) * 12345678901234567890 as d"]
["select cast(1.10 as decimal(10,2)) as d"]
["select cast(1 as money) as m, cast(1 as smallmoney) as sm"]
["select cast(1234.5678 as money) as m"]
["select cast(10 as decimal(5,2)) / 3 as d"]

# --- strings, markdown escaping, unicode ---
["select 'plain' as s"]
["select '[*/|`_<&]' as s"]
["select '\\\"' bq, '\\\\' bb, 'a\\b' ab"]
["select '>gt not escaped<' as s"]
["select '  leading spaces' as s"]
["select space(3) + 'x' as s"]
["select 'a' + char(9) + 'tab' as s"]
["select 'line1' + char(10) + 'line2' as s"]
["select 'line1' + char(13) + 'line2' as s"]
["select 'line1' + char(13) + char(10) + '  line2' as s"]
["select N'héllo wörld' as s"]
["select N'日本語' as s"]
["select N'😀 emoji' as s"]
["select '' as empty_string"]
["select cast(null as varchar(10)) as n"]
["select replicate('a', 100) as s"]
["select cast('a' as char(10)) as c, len(cast('a' as char(10))) as l"]
["select '```' as s"]
["select 1 as [a|b*c]"]
["select 1 as [ leading]"]
["select 'a' as [日本], 2 as [x_y]"]

# --- binary and uniqueidentifier ---
["select cast(0xDEADBEEF as varbinary(8)) as v"]
["select cast(0x00 as binary(4)) as b"]
["select cast('abc' as varbinary(10)) as v"]
["select cast(0x as varbinary(10)) as v"]
["select convert(uniqueidentifier, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001') as g"]
["select cast(null as varbinary(4)) as v"]

# --- date and time, incl. the precisionFormat scale rules ---
["select cast('2020-06-15' as date) as d"]
["select cast('2020-06-15 13:45' as smalldatetime) as sd"]
["select cast('2020-06-15 13:45:56.789' as datetime) as dt"]
["select cast('2020-06-15 13:45:56.1234567' as datetime2(7)) as dt2"]
["select cast('2020-06-15 13:45:56.123' as datetime2(3)) as dt2"]
["select cast('2020-06-15 13:45:56' as datetime2(0)) as dt2"]
["select cast('13:45:56.1234567' as time(7)) as t"]
["select cast('13:45:56' as time(0)) as t"]
["select cast('2020-06-15 13:45:56.1234567 +05:30' as datetimeoffset(7)) as dto"]
["select cast('2020-06-15 13:45:56 -08:00' as datetimeoffset(0)) as dto"]
["select datediff(day, '2020-01-01', '2021-01-01') as d"]
["select dateadd(month, 1, cast('2020-01-31' as date)) as d"]
["select convert(varchar(30), cast('2020-06-15 13:45:00' as datetime), 100) as c"]
["select convert(varchar(30), cast('2020-06-15 13:45:00' as datetime), 113) as c"]
["select datename(month, cast('2020-06-15' as date)) as m, datename(weekday, cast('2020-06-15' as date)) as w"]

# --- xml (PrettyXml), sql_variant, json ---
["select cast('<a><b>1</b><c d=\"2\"/></a>' as xml) as x"]
["select cast('<r><i>1</i><i>2</i></r>' as xml) as x"]
["select (select 1 as a, 'b' as b for xml path('row'), type) as x"]
["select cast(1 as sql_variant) as v, cast('s' as sql_variant) as w"]
["select isjson('{\"a\":1}') as j"]
["select json_value('{\"a\":1,\"b\":\"x\"}', '$.b') as j"]

# --- CLR UDTs: the dotMorten cross-platform port has to match Windows ToString() ---
["select geometry::STGeomFromText('POINT(1 2)', 0) as g"]
["select geometry::STGeomFromText('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 1, 2 4)', 0).STLength() as len"]
["select geography::STGeomFromText('POINT(-1.2 51.5)', 4326) as g"]
["select geography::STGeomFromText('POLYGON((0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 1, 0 0))', 4326).STArea() as a"]
["select hierarchyid::Parse('/1/2/') as h"]
["select hierarchyid::GetRoot().ToString() as h"]

# --- DDL / DML / rows-affected / multiple result sets ---
["create table t(a int)"]
["create table t(a int); insert t values (1),(2),(3); select * from t order by a"]
["create table t(a int); insert t values (1); update t set a = 2; delete from t"]
["create table t(a int)", "insert t values(1),(2)", "select * from t order by a"]
["declare @t table(a int); insert @t values(1),(2); select count(*) as c from @t"]
["select * from (values(1),(2),(3)) v(a) order by a"]
["select 1 as a; select 2 as b"]
["select 1 as a select 2 as b"]
["create table t(a int); insert t values(1),(2); select * from t order by a; select count(*) as c from t"]
["set nocount on; create table t(a int); insert t values(1); select * from t"]
["with c as (select 1 as a union all select 2) select a, sum(a) over () as s from c order by a"]

# --- messages: print / raiserror severity 0 land in the status fence ---
["print 'hello'"]
["print 'a' print 'b'"]
["raiserror('informational', 0, 1)"]
["print '```'"]
["print 'multi' + char(10) + 'line'"]
["create table t(a int); insert t values(1); print 'after insert'; select * from t"]

# --- errors ---
["select * from no_such_table"]
["select no_such_column from (select 1 as a) t"]
["selec 1"]
["select 1/0"]
["select cast(2147483647 as int) + 1"]
["select cast('abc' as int)"]
["select convert(datetime, '2020-13-01')"]
["raiserror('custom error', 16, 1)"]
["create table t(a int constraint pk_t primary key); insert t values(1); insert t values(1)"]
["create table t(a int constraint ck_t check (a > 0)); insert t values(-1)"]
["create table t(a int not null); insert t values(null)"]
["select 1", "select * from no_such_table", "select 2"]
["select 1; select * from no_such_table; select 2"]
["create table t(a int); insert t values(1); select * from t order by a; select 1/0"]
["execute no_such_proc"]
["drop table no_such_table"]

[""]
["   "]
["\n"]
["select 1;"]
["select 1 ", " select 2"]
